scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1 (Finite States), Chapter 10: Continuous Time. Scalar and matrix exponentials, the memoryless property, linear flows and uniqueness for x' = Ax, the spectral bound, the spectral mapping theorem for the exponential and the stability characterisation (Theorem 10.1.5), C0-semigroups and their generators, intensity matrices and Markov semigroups, Kolmogorov backward and forward equations, jump chains, lifetime valuation in continuous time (Propositions 10.2.1 and 10.2.3), continuous-time Markov decision processes via abstract dynamic programs (Theorem 10.2.4), and continuous-time job search; with the Chapter 9 ADP and order-stability layer and the earlier finite-state results it depends on restated.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1: Finite States, Chapter 10, pp. 308-341.
